files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Listening habits
New screen, for the plays Music sends with their exact time (Music 3.3.0 or later), over the same periods as the dashboard:
- Listening clock: plays by day of the week and hour, day and hour you listen most, time of day, weekend share.
- Listening sessions (no break of more than 30 minutes): number, average length, tracks per session, length distribution, longest session.
- Days with music, longest streak and current streak.
- Artist sequences ("after this artist, you often play…") and track sequences between two albums.
- Tracks on repeat and albums played in full.

### Yearly recap
- "Your listening habits": hour and day you listen most, plays by hour, sessions, longest session and streak, albums played in full, top track on repeat and artist sequence. Recaps saved before 1.1.0 stay unchanged.

### Dashboard
- Link to the listening habits from the listening time note.

### API
- `GET /api/v1/habits?from=…&to=…`.
